title: Think like an engineer
about: Predict, test, explain, improve. And why you change one thing at a time.

html: Engineers don't guess. They follow a cycle.
1. Predict: "If I change this, I think that will happen, because..."

• Test: try it.
  • Explain: why did it happen? (The flight report helps.)
  • Improve: change something and test again.
Change only one thing at a time. If you change two things and the result changes, you can't tell which one caused it.

steps.q: Maya changed her car's body to carbon fiber AND added 4 nozzles. It flew higher. Which change made it fly higher?
options: We can't tell, because she changed two things
steps.explain: Both changes could raise the height. To know for sure, change one at a time.

steps.q: Leo's car crashed. What should he do first?
options: Read the flight report to find out why
steps.explain: The report tells you what went wrong, so your next change has a reason.

options: If I add 2 lift nozzles, the car will fly higher, because thrust goes up.
steps.explain: A good prediction says what will change, and why.
